author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Great post but I think you sell short how much organizing the #indieweb community has done over the last 7-10 years.

Getting to this point to massive organization from committed enthusiasts.

What we need is not more organization but more organizers.

It is not up to the #indieweb community to grow the movement, that is your job, my, job and then it belongs to those we onboard.

Organize a HomeBrew Web club in your town. Convince a small business they need a website and not just a facebook page. Make a series of instructional videos to pass around your circles.
